newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AHC buys hospital for A$57.2 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AHC buys hospital for A$57.2 mln.

text.p: Australian Hospital Care Ltd (AHC) said on Tuesday it would acquire the Allamanda private hospital in Southport, Queensland, for A$57.2 million.
AHC said the purchase for the 214 bed hospital included A$50 million in cash and the issue to the vendors of four million AHC share at an agreed price of A$1.80 per share.
"Australian Hospital Care Ltd expects this new acquisition will have a positive impact on its net after tax profit and earnings per share during the first year of ownership," it said.
"The cash component of the acquisition was financed from existing cash and banking facilities," AHC said.
AHC shares closed three cents up at A$2.67.
